cds.title: University of Michigan-Flint Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF, linked from the Institutional Analysis Common Data Set page)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2024); totals are men + women + unknown and match the C1 residency total row. The CDS residency breakdown (in-state / out-of-state / international) is internally inconsistent as printed (e.g. enrolled in-state 1,054 against 555 total enrolled), so international applicants and admits are left null. 2025-2026 CDS not found: the Institutional Analysis site blocks automated access and the newest CDS on its page (Internet Archive copy, Aug 2025) is 2024-2025. Undergraduate enrollment is the B1 total (5,011, includes part-time and non-degree students); intl_undergrads is the B2 nonresident total (59). Student-to-faculty ratio 14:1 (CDS I-2). The 'Percent in top tenth/quarter' class-rank entries in C10 look unreliable (based on 1 reporting student) and are not used. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-time students who submitted scores (SAT 64%, ACT 3%).

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, 2024-2025): in-state tuition $14,208, out-of-state and non-resident $27,744, required fees $682, food and housing $12,854; G5 books $700, other $1,310. CDS H6: only institutional non-need-based aid for nonresidents; 30 nonresidents awarded, average $5,815. The current International Tuition & Fees page (year not printed; captured Aug 2026) lists undergraduate lower-division tuition of $29,002 for 12 credits per semester, with estimated total international expenses of $45,215 (living $11,943, health insurance $2,470, books $800, miscellaneous $1,000); mandatory fees are not included.
